name: Infantile haemangioma & vascular malformations
general: Most infantile haemangiomas involute; treat early (first 5 months is the proliferation window) if risk: periocular, airway (beard area), lip, nasal tip, large facial (PHACE — echo, MRI brain), ulcerated, multiple (>5 — liver ultrasound). Vascular malformations do not involute.

rx.instr: Give with feeds; hold if not eating (hypoglycaemia); check HR, BP at start

rx.drug: Ulcer care: barrier dressings, topical antibiotic, pain relief
Pulsed dye laser (port-wine stain, residual telangiectasia)
Oral prednisolone 2–3 mg/kg / Sirolimus (lymphatic & complex malformations) / sclerotherapy / surgery
